Supply Chain Analytics & Data Strategy Consulting

Why Moonlytix

Clear decisions from complex data.

Moonlytix helps mid-sized companies turn complex operational data into clear, confident business decisions. We begin with supply chain analytics, helping teams reduce inventory waste, prevent stockouts, improve forecasting, evaluate supplier performance, optimize transportation costs, and improve operational productivity through modern data systems, dashboards, and actionable recommendations.

Many growing companies have data everywhere, but no clear system for turning that data into operational decisions.

Operational data often lives across spreadsheets, ERP systems, logistics platforms, sales channels, warehouse tools, and disconnected reports. Moonlytix helps companies organize that complexity and turn it into clear, actionable decisions.

Scattered Data

Data lives across multiple systems, spreadsheets, and teams.

Reactive Reporting

Teams know what happened, but struggle to understand what comes next.

Operational Blind Spots

Inventory, suppliers, transportation, productivity, and delivery performance are difficult to see clearly.

Unclear Decisions

Leaders need better visibility to understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what decision to make next.
